description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWordGate component of the SwabbleKit project. It defines test cases to verify correct matching behavior of wake word commands, handling of gaps, multi-word triggers, and command text extraction within the wake word detection system.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: Test suite for WakeWordGate's functionality, including trigger matching, gap requirements, multi-word triggers, and command extraction.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the wake word trigger requires a minimum gap after the trigger word before a command can be recognized.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Verifies that the system correctly matches a trigger with sufficient post-trigger gap and extracts the subsequent command.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Checks that multi-word trigger phrases are correctly recognized as triggers.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Ensures that command text extraction handles cases where segment ranges refer to substrings outside the main transcript's range.
